claude-code.label: Claude Code
claude-code.restore_note: Re-add marketplaces and /plugin install your plugins, then run `claude` to log in again.

ollama.label: Ollama
ollama.restore_note: Run `ollama pull <name>` (or `ollama create` from the saved Modelfile) for each model.

lmstudio.label: LM Studio
lmstudio.restore_note: Re-download models in LM Studio; presets/config are restored.

gpt4all.label: GPT4All
gpt4all.restore_note: Re-download models in GPT4All; settings are restored.

jan.label: Jan
jan.restore_note: Re-download models in Jan; assistants/threads/settings are restored.

aichat.label: aichat
aichat.restore_note: Set your provider API keys again; roles/sessions/config are restored.

llm.label: llm (datasette)
llm.restore_note: Run `llm keys set <provider>` again; templates/plugins/logs are restored.

anthropic-cloud.label: Anthropic API
anthropic-cloud.restore_note: Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY on the new machine.

openai-cloud.label: OpenAI API
openai-cloud.restore_note: Set OPENAI_API_KEY on the new machine.

google-cloud.label: Google AI API
google-cloud.restore_note: Set GEMINI_API_KEY / GOOGLE_API_KEY on the new machine.

mistral-cloud.label: Mistral API
mistral-cloud.restore_note: Set MISTRAL_API_KEY on the new machine.

groq-cloud.label: Groq API
groq-cloud.restore_note: Set GROQ_API_KEY on the new machine.

local-weights.label: Local weight files
local-weights.restore_note: Re-download the listed .gguf/.safetensors files; only their paths are recorded.
